CREATE LIGHTNING REST TABLE ndc_atropine FROM OPENFDA_REST REQUEST(
    endpoint "https://api.fda.gov/drug/ndc.json?search=generic_name:%22atropine%22&limit=1000",
    method "get",
    response_type "json",
    http_encoding "URLENCODED"
) HEADER (
) BODY ()

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW ndc_atropine_view WITH CONTAINER fda AS
SELECT r.product_ndc, r.labeler_name, r.brand_name, r.generic_name, r.dosage_form, r.application_number, r.marketing_category,
       r.listing_expiration_date, r.dea_schedule AS dea_schedule,
       concat_ws('; ', transform(r.active_ingredients, a -> concat(a.name, ' ', a.strength))) AS strength,
       concat_ws(' | ', transform(r.packaging, p -> p.package_ndc)) AS package_ndcs,
       concat_ws(' | ', transform(r.packaging, p -> p.description)) AS package_descriptions
FROM openfda_rest.ndc_atropine LATERAL VIEW explode(results) AS r

CREATE LIGHTNING FILESTORE TABLE ndc_atropine_snapshot FROM FDA_FILES FORMAT PARQUET OPTIONS (
  path "file:///home/zetaris/customer-data/shared/snapshots/ndc_atropine_snapshot/202610221551",
  sourceTable "fda.ndc_atropine_view"
)
